        """Test that adding an emoji reaction creates/updates a Community Interaction entry"""
    
        # Ensure we have prerequisites

        emoji_type = "thumbsUp"

        updated_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
    
        assert updated_today_count >= initial_today_count, \
            "Today's count should not decrease after emoji"
